photos.title: Part of Auberon Woods in Conway from above, cleared for building (USDA NAIP, April 10, 2023)
photos.what: About 1,000 m by 750 m of land in Auberon Woods, Conway, seen from above on April 10, 2023: cleared ground with stumps, a bare graded area, new dirt roads and ponds, with pine woods around it. No finished houses are in the frame.
photos.caption: Part of Auberon Woods in Conway from above, cleared for building.
photos.alt: Aerial view of cleared woodland and bare graded ground with new dirt roads and ponds, surrounded by pine woods, with no houses yet

place.sublocation: Auberon Woods, outside Conway city limits (Horry County tax district 100)

photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP

photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm, flown 2023-04-10 (tile m_3307810_nw_17_060_20230410, from the image service's catalog query at the spot; the service holds no later year there). Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023), 1,000 m by 750 m at 2400 by 1800 px, centered on 33.82629 N, 78.85293 W (findings-verified.json top_community, the middle of Auberon Woods' sold parcels); the exact request is in source_request. Resized to 1200 x 900 and 600 x 450, no crop, no marks.
photos.subject_check: Checked 2026-11-08 by the writer: Horry County parcel layer 24 at the center point returns LegalDescr 'AUBERON WOODS PH 5B; Lot 372', land use 101 (residential), tax district 100. map-points.json (the kept builder sales, verifier's rules) has 176 sale points inside the frame, every one a D.R. Horton sale. Looked at full size (2400 x 1800) and at 1200 px: cleared ground with stumps, a graded pad area, dirt roads, three ponds and pine woods; no house, person, plate or sign is readable at 60 cm.
